title: Arbitrary JSON Blobs in Domain Models
pattern: Storing core domain parameters or attributes using unstructured JSON payloads (`serde_json::Value`).
why_bad: It completely bypasses type validation. It allows invalid schema variations to propagate into the database, making runtime business logic fragile to parsing failures and requiring defensive deserialization logic.
detection: Struct fields typed as raw JSON or BSON objects inside domain models.
counterexample: A database column storing raw external webhook logs for auditing or debugging purposes.
fix:
Parse the incoming payload into a strongly-typed schema before passing it into the domain model.
```rust
struct OrderMetadata {
    referral_source: Option<String>,
    campaign_id: Option<u32>,
}
```
source: *Domain Modeling made Functional* by Scott Wlaschin (p. 110).
